notes.title: Minor update - fix main menu wishlist button
notes.notes:
On the 27th of July we pushed a tiny update to fix the Bore Blasters button on the main menu. Due to engine updates this also had the unintended consequence of disabling gamepad controls. When we were notified of this, we reverted the build.

On the 28th of July we have pushed a build that fixes the button [i]without[/i] impacting gamepad controls. If there are any issues, please report in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2005210/discussions/]discussions[/url] section.

Thanks to those that reported the issue in the first place, and apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: QoL update
notes.notes:
Display number of scrap ups achieved in HUD

Display health when offered the “Restore Shield” upgrade

To avoid confusion, “Restore Shield” is now capped so that x2 or x3 is not offered when it would heal more than the damage taken

Fixed: When selecting weapons with mouse, if the cursor is not moved after clicking reroll once, trying to click a second time will select the card in the center instead of reroll

Attempt to detect when stat descriptions exceed card space to ensure descriptions are readable (primarily impacted German translation)

notes.title: Background Update
notes.notes:
Updated backgrounds to reduce motion sickness

Added outline to currently selected upgrade/weapon

Fixed clipping issue in unlock display on game over screen

Changed layout of language confirmation screen

notes.title: Hotfix 1.28
notes.notes: Implemented fix for crash on launch related to applying previously used window size.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.20
notes.notes:
Show upgrade group icons in bottom left of in-game HUD

Ultimate weapons are now described when offered, replacing the description of the standard weapon

Fixed garbage collection bug that causes slowdown when game is left idling

Nerfed scrap magnet permanent upgrade

notes.title: Hotfix 1.18
notes.notes:
Updated Prismatrix prism colouring for improved clarity

Further tweaks to end game (additional new destroyer type)

Restarting game or exiting to main menu now stores credits gained during run

notes.title: End Game Update
notes.notes:
Changed end game, introducing new enemy type and restricting to one final boss kill.

Tweaked visual feedback from defeating final boss.

Fix: Applied a failsafe for player damage, with the intent to prevent “ghost hits” (where the player is damaged even when nothing is nearby). PLEASE REPORT IF THIS STILL HAPPENS!

Buffed Prismatrix orbiting prism (increased range, trigger frequency, hitbox size)

Fix: Gamepad Start now pauses the game

Fix: Restrict certain types of input from being mapped

Scaled up damage numbers to better illustrate changes in damage

notes.title: Hotfix 1.10
notes.notes:
Limited the amount of damage numbers that can spawn, in order to safeguard performance.

Fixed error generated by spawning too many damage numbers.

Fixed permanent upgrades not being updated properly.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.8
notes.notes: Fixed unlock "Fire 3000 projectiles in a Pyrek run."

notes.title: Hotfix 1.7
notes.notes:
Fixed unlock “Stand still for 30 seconds.”

Fixed unlock  “Kill 5 bosses with an explosive weapon.”

Tweaked player ship sprites

Tweaked final boss hit animation

notes.title: Hotfix 1.6
notes.notes:
Fix crash on new game

Attempted fix for black screen bug on menu selection. This is likely related to input being registered twice - which means new issues are likely to crop up. We will continue to investigate but this is a tricky issue.

Improved “no shield damage boost” effect (made it subtler)

Game now saves window size and position when not using fullscreen

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.notes:
* Fixed bug preventing some unlocks requiring a specific type of weapon
* Fixed outdated credits amounts shown in Permanent Upgrades menu

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Changes since last version:

* Fixed UI not respecting screen shake settings
* Fixed sporadically invincible boss bug
* Fixed bug associated with "Always draw your most upgraded card" skill
* Added a new music track

notes.title: Release date announced
notes.notes: Strap in and scrap up - Void Scrappers is releasing on Friday October 21st!
